history.summary: A 420 sqft shoebox freehold 1BR in D14 at $1869 PSF / $785k, 520m from Paya Lebar interchange. The asking PSF is ~12% ABOVE the project URA median of $1673, and the resale-only CAGR is a weak ~2.0% — a poor value/growth combination despite the good location.
history.rating_rationale: $1869 PSF is ~12% above the project's own $1673 URA median, while resale-only appreciation is only ~2.0%/yr (15 txns) — below OCR baseline and well below D14 peers in this batch. A 420 sqft true shoebox has the shallowest exit pool and weakest appreciation profile. Paying a premium for a slow-growing shoebox is the wrong side of the value equation; low Elo (1039) and losing record (111-179) corroborate.
red_flags: Asking PSF ~12% above project URA median
Resale-only CAGR only ~2.0%/yr — below OCR baseline
420 sqft true shoebox — shallowest buyer pool and weakest resale
catalysts: Paya Lebar interchange 520m — supports rental demand
Low absolute quantum ($785k) keeps entry affordable
